scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Google Cloud external run-rate exceeds $100B annualized with segment operating margin expanding to 24% driven by Vertex AI enterprise monetization.
AI Overviews click-through rates and high-intent commercial ad query monetization inflect positively, maintaining Search query volume dominance above 90%.
TPU v6 Trillium internal deployment suppresses unit inference serving costs by 45% compared to merchant accelerator clusters.

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Search revenue compounds at 10-12% while YouTube CTV and Shorts monetization continues robust double-digit expansion.
Google Cloud maintains 35-40% growth with stable 18-20% operating margins.
DOJ antitrust remedies remain limited to behavioral and contract-choice frameworks without structural asset divestitures.

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Judicial antitrust remedies mandate the unbundling of default search distribution on Apple iOS and Android OEM agreements.
Generative AI conversational search alternatives modestly fragment top-of-funnel informational queries.
Aggressive technical infrastructure CapEx drives elevated depreciation schedules, compressing corporate operating margins to 28%.
